title: Transformer 为什么更适合并行训练？

goal: 分清训练中的位置并行与生成时的自回归依赖。
Separate parallel training positions from autoregressive generation.
problem: 循环网络的下一状态依赖上一状态，序列维度难以完全并行。2017 年 Transformer 用注意力连接位置，让一层中各位置的计算可组织成矩阵运算。它消除的是层内的循环路径，并没有消除层与层的依赖。

Recurrent states depend on preceding states, limiting parallelism over positions. The 2017 Transformer connects positions through attention and expresses each layer as matrix operations. This removes within-layer recurrence, not dependencies between layers.
mechanism: 训练时完整目标序列已知，右移后的真实 token 作为输入；因果掩码阻止位置读取未来答案。QKᵀ 为各位置计算相关性，softmax 后加权 V。解码时未来 token 尚未知，普通自回归模型仍需生成一个再生成下一个；KV cache 只能省去历史 K/V 的重复计算。

During training the target sequence is known. Shifted ground-truth tokens are inputs and a causal mask hides future tokens. QKᵀ scores positions, and softmax weights V. During decoding future tokens are unknown: ordinary autoregressive generation still produces them sequentially. KV caching avoids recomputing past keys and values.
example: 教学图：训练 [A,B,C]→[B,C,D] 时，三个位置的损失可在同一前向过程中得到；生成时必须先得到 B 才能把 B 作为下一步输入。并行程度取决于批量、序列长度、硬件和实现。

Teaching example: training [A,B,C]→[B,C,D] can compute losses at all three positions in one forward pass. Generation must obtain B before using B as the next input. Actual parallelism depends on batch size, sequence length, hardware and implementation.

Dense attention scores grow quadratically with sequence length. More parallelism does not mean less total computation; long contexts introduce memory, IO, positional representation and data-coverage constraints.

title: SFT、奖励模型、RLHF 分别解决什么？

goal: 从预测文本转向利用示范和偏好。

problem: 预训练擅长延续文本，却不直接以“满足指令”为目标。InstructGPT 将人类示范与比较反馈引入后训练，使训练信号更贴近期望行为。示范质量、标注者偏好和任务覆盖都会影响最终行为。

Pretraining learns text continuation rather than directly optimizing instruction fulfillment. InstructGPT adds demonstrations and comparative feedback during post-training. Demonstration quality, annotator preferences and task coverage shape behavior.
mechanism: SFT 用示范答案做监督学习；奖励模型从同一提示下的答案排序学习打分；RL 阶段生成答案并优化奖励，同时通常用与参考策略的偏离约束稳定训练。这是一个具体流程，RLHF 也包含其他实现，不应把 PPO 当作唯一方法。

SFT learns from demonstrated answers. A reward model learns scores from answer rankings for the same prompt. RL then samples answers and optimizes reward, typically constraining deviation from a reference policy. This is one concrete pipeline; RLHF does not uniquely imply PPO.
example: 目标式是概念简化：奖励越高越好，但偏离参考策略会付出代价。β 太小可能过度追逐奖励漏洞；太大又限制行为变化。具体实现的 KL 估计、采样和优化细节必须回到论文。

This simplified objective rewards better scores but penalizes deviation. Too little regularization can exploit reward errors; too much can prevent useful change. KL estimators, sampling and optimization details belong to the specific implementation.
limit: 学到的奖励不是事实正确性的证明。偏好模型可能偏爱长度或语气；优化器也可能放大评分漏洞。必须用独立任务评估、人工检查和分布外测试检验收益。

A learned reward is not proof of factual correctness. Preferences may favor length or tone, and optimization can amplify scoring loopholes. Validate using independent tasks, human review and out-of-distribution tests.

labels: 答案比较 → 奖励模型
caption: InstructGPT 后训练机制的简化重绘。
Simplified redraw of InstructGPT post-training.

title: DPO 为何可以省掉独立奖励模型？
Why can DPO omit a separate reward model?
goal: 理解隐式奖励与离线偏好对的作用。
Understand implicit rewards and offline preference pairs.
problem: 基于奖励模型的 RLHF 包含奖励拟合、在线采样和策略优化等环节。DPO 利用 KL 正则化奖励最大化问题的关系，把偏好学习写成直接针对策略的分类式目标，减少训练流程中的独立组件。

Reward-model RLHF includes reward fitting, online sampling and policy optimization. DPO uses the relationship in KL-regularized reward maximization to turn preference learning into a classification-like policy objective, reducing separate training components.
mechanism: 对同一提示 x 的胜者 y_w 与败者 y_l，比较当前策略相对于参考策略的对数概率比。提高胜者的相对优势，不需要先训练一个单独的标量奖励网络。这依赖论文中的偏好模型与优化推导；并不意味着无需偏好数据或参考策略。

For a winner y_w and loser y_l under prompt x, compare log-probability ratios between current and reference policies. Increase the winner’s relative advantage without first fitting a separate scalar reward network. The derivation assumes a preference model; preference data and a reference policy are still needed.
example: 若胜者相对参考策略的比值为 2、败者为 1，括号中的优势为 log 2；反过来则为 −log 2。目标鼓励区分偏好对，不保证答案绝对概率上升，也不是对事实真假的直接判别。

If the winner’s ratio to reference is 2 and the loser’s is 1, the margin is log 2; reversed it is −log 2. The objective separates pairs. It does not guarantee an increase in absolute answer probability or directly judge factual truth.
limit: 离线偏好覆盖不到的新策略行为仍可能出错。噪声偏好、长度偏差、β 和参考策略选择都会影响结果。Meta 披露 Llama 3.1 使用 SFT 与 DPO，不说明所有公司的后训练都采用这条路线。

New policy behavior outside offline preference coverage can still fail. Noisy labels, length bias, β and the reference choice matter. Meta reports SFT and DPO for Llama 3.1; this does not establish every company’s training recipe.

labels: 提示 x + 胜者 y_w

策略／参考比值 → 偏好损失

Compare relative probabilities of complete answers to the same prompt.

title: 可验证奖励怎样塑造推理行为？
How do verifiable rewards shape reasoning?
goal: 区分 R1-Zero 探索与 R1 多阶段训练。
Distinguish R1-Zero from the multistage R1 pipeline.
problem: 示范微调受限于可用的优质推理轨迹。在数学答案可核验、代码可测试的部分任务中，结果反馈能提供强化学习信号，让模型通过采样与更新调整求解行为。奖励仍只覆盖验证器能够检查的部分。

Supervised reasoning is limited by available high-quality traces. Some math answers and code outputs can be checked, providing RL signals through sampling and updates. The reward only covers what the verifier can actually check.
mechanism: R1-Zero 探索了不先做 SFT 的直接 RL；R1 则采用冷启动数据和多阶段训练，不能把两者混为同一配方。GRPO 用同一问题一组候选的相对奖励构造优势估计，配合策略约束更新；最终答案奖励并不逐步证明推理过程正确。

R1-Zero explores direct RL without preliminary SFT. R1 uses cold-start data and multiple stages. GRPO estimates advantages from relative rewards within a group of candidates for one prompt, then updates the constrained policy. Outcome rewards do not prove every reasoning step correct.
example: 教学算例：四个候选奖励 [0,0,1,1]，相对优势将正确候选与错误候选分开；若整组同分则没有这种区分信号，实现需处理零方差。OpenAI o1 公开了推理 RL 方向，但不能据此断言它采用同一奖励和算法。

Example: rewards [0,0,1,1] distinguish correct from incorrect candidates. Equal group rewards provide no such discrimination, and implementations must handle zero variance. OpenAI describes reasoning RL for o1, but this does not establish identical rewards or algorithms.
limit: 验证器可能被绕过，测试用例可能不完整，容易验证的任务也不代表所有开放问题。要同时检查泛化、可读性、长度成本和奖励漏洞，不把生成更长解释直接当成推理能力提升。

Verifiers can be exploited and tests can be incomplete. Easily checked tasks do not represent all open-ended problems. Check generalization, readability, length costs and reward hacking; longer explanations alone are not evidence of better reasoning.

labels: 同一问题 → 一组候选

Relative-reward sketch, not the entire R1 training recipe.

title: KV cache 为什么随上下文和并发增长？
Why does KV cache grow with context and concurrency?
goal: 把缓存容量写成可检查的 MiB 算式。
Turn cache capacity into a checkable MiB calculation.
problem: 自回归解码不断读取历史 token 的键和值。缓存它们可避免重复投影，但每个请求、每一层都要保留历史状态；更长的输入和输出、更高并发都会推高容量与带宽需求。

Autoregressive decoding repeatedly reads keys and values for past tokens. Caching avoids repeated projections, but every request and layer retains history. Longer inputs and outputs and higher concurrency increase memory and bandwidth demand.
mechanism: 标准 MHA／MQA／GQA 的理想 KV 载荷为 2×B×L×T×H_kv×d×s 字节，2 对应 K 与 V；B 是等长请求数，L 是层数，T 是每个请求当前缓存长度，H_kv 是 KV 头数，d 是头维度，s 是每元素字节。异长请求用各自 T 求和。

For standard MHA/MQA/GQA, ideal KV payload is 2×B×L×T×H_kv×d×s bytes. The 2 counts K and V; B is equal-length requests, L layers, T cached tokens per request, H_kv KV heads, d head dimension and s bytes per element. Sum individual lengths for unequal requests.
questions.formula: KV_MiB = 2 B L T H_kv d s / 2²⁰
example: 默认教学配置 B=1、L=32、T=4096、H_kv=8、d=128、s=2，得到 512 MiB；8 个这样的请求需要 4096 MiB。下方计算器只计算缓存载荷，不包括权重、激活、工作区、分页碎片、量化元数据与副本。

Default teaching configuration B=1, L=32, T=4096, H_kv=8, d=128, s=2 gives 512 MiB; eight such requests need 4096 MiB. The calculator excludes weights, activations, workspace, fragmentation, quantization metadata and replicas.
limit: 容量减小不自动等于相同比例提速：decode 可能受带宽、计算或调度限制。MLA 使用不同的压缩表示，不能把这条标准 KV 公式直接套作其精确容量。

Smaller capacity does not imply proportional speedup: decode may be limited by bandwidth, compute or scheduling. MLA has a different compressed representation; this standard formula is not its exact memory model.

caption: 载荷乘数示意；下方数值可交互调整。
Payload factors; adjust the calculator below.

title: MQA、GQA 和 MLA 分别怎样减少 KV？
How do MQA, GQA and MLA reduce KV?
goal: 共享 KV 头与压缩潜变量是不同的设计。
Shared KV heads and latent compression are distinct designs.
problem: Query 头可以学习不同的关注方式，但为每个 Query 头保留独立 K/V 会扩大缓存。2019 年 MQA、2023 年 GQA 探索共享 K/V；DeepSeek 的 MLA 则改变缓存表示。
Query heads can attend differently, but independent K/V for every query head increases cache. MQA (2019) and GQA (2023) explore shared K/V; DeepSeek’s MLA changes the cached representation.
mechanism: MHA 中 H_kv=H_q；MQA 中所有 Query 头共享一组 KV，H_kv=1；GQA 则有 1<H_kv<H_q 个组。MLA 使用低维联合潜变量及其解压映射，并处理位置表示相关分量。它不是简单把 GQA 组数继续减小。

MHA has H_kv=H_q. MQA shares one KV set across query heads, H_kv=1. GQA uses an intermediate group count. MLA uses a low-dimensional joint latent representation, reconstruction mappings and positional components. It is not simply a smaller GQA group count.
questions.formula: MHA → GQA: ideal KV ratio = H_kv / H_q
example: 教学配置 32 个 Query 头、8 个 KV 头，在其余条件相同时，GQA 载荷为 MHA 的四分之一。Meta Llama 3 的 8B／70B 披露 GQA；DeepSeek-V3 披露 MLA；这些是具体型号的证据。
With 32 query heads and 8 KV heads, GQA has one quarter of MHA’s ideal payload, all else equal. Meta discloses GQA in Llama 3 8B/70B, and DeepSeek-V3 discloses MLA. These are model-specific examples.
limit: 共享程度与模型质量存在取舍，需要训练或转换与验证；压缩表示依赖模型结构和内核支持。不能仅改服务端参数就无损把任意模型改成 MLA，也不能直接用载荷比推断吞吐比。

Sharing trades against model quality and requires training or conversion and validation. Latent representations need architecture and kernel support. A serving setting cannot losslessly turn any model into MLA, and payload ratios do not determine throughput ratios.

labels: MLA：压缩潜变量 + 位置分量
caption: 表示结构对照；MLA 的精确缓存需按实现计算。
Representation comparison; calculate MLA memory for its implementation.

title: 推测解码如何加速又保持目标分布？
How can speculative decoding preserve the target distribution?
goal: 接受／拒绝与校正采样缺一不可。
Acceptance, rejection and correction all matter.
problem: 大模型逐 token 调用有串行成本。较便宜的草稿模型先提出多个 token，再由目标模型一次前向验证候选位置；若接受足够多，就可用较少昂贵步骤推进多 token。

Calling a large model token by token incurs sequential cost. A cheaper draft proposes several tokens and the target verifies their positions in one forward pass. Sufficient acceptance advances multiple tokens per expensive step.
mechanism: 令目标分布为 p、草稿分布为 q，对草稿采样 token 的接受概率为 min(1,p/q)。首次拒绝后从归一化的正残差 max(0,p−q) 采样，并丢弃其后的草稿。完整接受／拒绝与校正算法在其假设下保持目标分布；并非简单选择目标模型最喜欢的草稿。

With target p and draft q, accept a proposed token with min(1,p/q). On the first rejection sample from the normalized positive residual max(0,p−q), discarding later draft tokens. The complete algorithm preserves the target distribution under its assumptions; simply picking the target’s favorite draft does not.
example: 教学算例：两词分布 p=(0.6,0.4)、q=(0.8,0.2)。第一个词接受率 0.75，第二个为 1；拒绝部分被校正为第二词，最终回到 p。Google 披露 AI Overviews 使用推测解码，未说明所有请求都获得同样加速。

Example: p=(0.6,0.4), q=(0.8,0.2). The first token is accepted with 0.75 and the second with 1. Rejected mass is corrected to the second token, recovering p. Google reports its use in AI Overviews, not uniform acceleration for every request.
limit: 收益取决于草稿成本、接受率、验证批量与服务器负载。温度、截断采样及数值实现也必须与目标分布定义一致。高并发、低接受率或昂贵草稿都可能抵消收益。

Gains depend on draft cost, acceptance, verification batch and server load. Temperature, truncation and numerical implementation must agree with the defined target distribution. High concurrency, low acceptance or costly drafts can erase the gain.

labels: 草稿 q：提出 k 个 token
caption: 精确采样方法重绘，不是任意草稿验证都无损。
Redraw of exact sampling; arbitrary draft verification is not necessarily lossless.

title: 长上下文为什么不等于可靠长记忆？
Why is a long context not reliable long-term memory?
goal: 窗口大小、位置信息与检索能力分开验证。
Test window size, positions and retrieval separately.
problem: 模型能够接收更多 token，只说明接口或结构允许更长输入，不证明能可靠使用其中每个事实。Lost in the Middle 在其被测模型和检索／问答任务中观察到位置敏感性：信息在中间时表现可能更差。

Accepting more tokens establishes an input capacity, not reliable use of every fact. Lost in the Middle found positional sensitivity in its tested models and retrieval/QA tasks, with information in the middle sometimes used less effectively.
mechanism: RoPE 将位置编码为 Query／Key 的旋转，使点积携带相对位置信息。扩展窗口还需要考虑训练长度分布、位置外推或缩放与验证；它不解决所有检索干扰。应把“放得下”“找得到”“推得对”分成三个测量。

RoPE rotates queries and keys so their dot products encode relative position. Extending windows also requires training-length coverage, positional extrapolation or scaling and validation. It does not solve all retrieval interference. Measure capacity, retrieval and reasoning separately.
questions.formula: dense attention work ∝ T²; standard KV payload ∝ T
example: 教学检查：将同一证据分别放在开头、中间、结尾，并加入相似干扰材料，比较引用正确性与回答质量。固定问题与长度才能隔离位置效应；历史研究结果不能直接当成今天所有模型的能力判定。

Teaching protocol: place the same evidence at the beginning, middle and end, adding similar distractors. Compare citation accuracy and answer quality while holding question and length fixed. Historical results are not a verdict on every current model.
limit: 长输入增加 prefill 成本与 KV 占用；压缩、检索和摘要可能漏掉关键细节。实际系统需要证据定位、引用检查与任务级评测，不能只依据最大窗口数字选型。

Long inputs increase prefill work and KV memory. Compression, retrieval and summaries may omit crucial details. Systems need evidence localization, citation checks and task-level evaluation rather than selection by maximum window size alone.

caption: 三个独立评价维度，不是自动依次达成的阶段。
Three distinct evaluation dimensions, not automatically achieved stages.

title: 更多推理计算应该花在何处？
Where should extra inference compute go?
goal: 在串行思考、并行候选与验证之间分配预算。
Allocate budget across serial reasoning, candidates and verification.
problem: 模型参数固定后，回答阶段仍可改变投入的计算。难题可能受益于更长求解过程或多候选搜索，但简单问题未必值得同样预算。2024 年研究将预算分配和问题难度联系起来，产品也开始提供思考预算。

With parameters fixed, answering compute can still vary. Hard problems may benefit from longer reasoning or candidate search; simple problems may not justify the same budget. Research in 2024 connected allocation to difficulty, while products exposed thinking budgets.
mechanism: 串行计算延长单条求解轨迹；并行计算产生多条候选；验证器或重排序决定选哪条。预算必须同时包含候选生成与评分，而不是只数最终返回的 token。不同难度、模型和验证器会产生不同的最优分配。

Serial compute extends one trajectory; parallel compute produces candidates; a verifier or ranker selects among them. Account for generation and scoring, not just returned tokens. Difficulty, model and verifier quality change the best allocation.
example: 教学对照：8 条短候选与 1 条长轨迹可能具有相近 token 预算，但关键路径延迟与错误相关性不同。o1、Claude 3.7 和 Qwen3 公开了不同形式的推理／思考能力；不能推断它们内部使用同一种搜索。

Eight short candidates and one long trajectory may have similar token budgets but different critical-path latency and correlated errors. o1, Claude 3.7 and Qwen3 disclose different reasoning/thinking capabilities, without establishing identical internal search.
limit: 更多计算可能反复强化错误。验证器不可靠时，多候选选择还可能挑中迎合评分的答案。应按任务画质量—成本—延迟曲线，并设置停止规则；没有一个通用“思考越久越好”的结论。

More compute can reinforce mistakes. An unreliable verifier may select candidates that exploit scoring. Measure task-specific quality–cost–latency curves and define stopping rules; longer thinking is not universally better.

caption: 预算分配示意，不推测闭源模型内部实现。
Allocation sketch; no inference about proprietary internals.

title: 低比特量化省了什么，又损失什么？
What does low-bit quantization save and sacrifice?
goal: 分开核算权重、激活和 KV 的精度。
Account for weights, activations and KV precision separately.
problem: 权重从高精度数转换为低比特编码可减少存储和读取流量，但量化误差可能改变模型行为。权重量化、激活量化与 KV 量化针对不同张量，不能用一个“4 bit”标签概括整个推理过程。

Low-bit weight codes reduce storage and read traffic, but quantization errors can change behavior. Weight, activation and KV quantization target different tensors; one “4-bit” label does not describe the entire inference process.
mechanism: 分组量化为一组数保存比例尺与可能的零点；编码舍入并截断，执行时直接使用低比特内核或反量化。AWQ 根据激活信息识别敏感权重并调整缩放，目标是在低比特权重量化中控制质量损失。

Grouped quantization stores a scale and sometimes a zero point per group. Codes are rounded and clipped, then consumed by low-bit kernels or dequantized. AWQ uses activation information to identify sensitive weights and adjust scaling, controlling losses in low-bit weight quantization.
example: 教学算例：10B 权重仅按编码计，FP16 约 20GB，4-bit 约 5GB（十进制）；实际还要加比例尺、零点和未量化张量。权重减小四倍不代表总显存或服务延迟也缩小四倍。

For 10B weights, payload alone is about 20GB in FP16 and 5GB at 4 bits (decimal). Add scales, zero points and unquantized tensors. Fourfold weight reduction does not imply fourfold reduction in total memory or latency.
limit: 异常值、校准数据与任务分布影响误差；硬件是否支持高效内核决定收益。上线前要验证长上下文、特定领域和输出一致性，不能只测一个平均分。

Outliers, calibration data and task distributions affect error. Efficient kernel support determines performance. Validate long contexts, domain tasks and output behavior rather than relying on one average score.

labels: 分组比例尺 + 低比特码
caption: 权重量化示意；不代表 KV 也已量化。
Weight quantization sketch; KV is not implicitly quantized.

title: ZeRO 把哪些训练状态分片了？
Which training states does ZeRO shard?
goal: 逐级拆开参数、梯度和优化器状态的冗余。
Remove redundancy in parameters, gradients and optimizer states.
problem: 普通数据并行在每张卡放一份模型和训练状态。Adam 的动量、方差及混合精度主权重会比前向权重本身占用更多空间。ZeRO 在保持数据并行思路的同时，把这些状态分散到多个设备。

Ordinary data parallelism replicates model and training states per device. Adam moments, variances and mixed-precision master weights can exceed forward-weight memory. ZeRO distributes those states while retaining data-parallel training.
mechanism: Stage 1 分片优化器状态；Stage 2 再分片梯度；Stage 3 进一步分片参数，计算某层时按需收集。用 P、G、O 表示参数、梯度、优化器字节数，理想每卡状态从 P+G+O 逐步变为 P+G+O/n、P+(G+O)/n、(P+G+O)/n。

Stage 1 shards optimizer states; Stage 2 also shards gradients; Stage 3 also shards parameters, gathering them when needed. With parameter, gradient and optimizer bytes P,G,O, ideal per-device state goes from P+G+O to P+G+O/n, P+(G+O)/n and (P+G+O)/n.
questions.formula: ZeRO-3 ideal state/device = (P + G + O) / n
example: 教学算例 P=2、G=2、O=12 字节／参数，n=4：复制状态为16，三个阶段理想值依次为7、5.5、4。不同精度与优化器的分项不同；这些不是峰值显存，未计激活、收集缓冲与通信工作区。

Example: P=2, G=2, O=12 bytes/parameter and n=4 gives 16 replicated bytes and ideal stage totals of 7, 5.5 and 4. Precision and optimizers change these terms. These are not peak-memory estimates; activations, gather buffers and workspaces are excluded.
limit: 更深分片会带来参数收集、通信和调度压力。有效性取决于网络、计算重叠和微批量；训练装得下之后还要解决吞吐，不可只按理论状态字节选配置。

Deeper sharding adds gathering, communication and scheduling pressure. Network, overlap and microbatch size matter. Fitting the model does not guarantee good throughput; choose configurations beyond theoretical state bytes.

caption: 三阶段状态分片重绘，未包含激活。
Three sharding stages, excluding activations.

title: 数据、张量、流水线和专家并行怎样组合？
How do data, tensor, pipeline and expert parallelism combine?
goal: 按切分对象与通信路径选择设备布局。
Choose device layouts by partition and communication path.
problem: 当单设备无法承担参数、激活或计算，系统必须分工。不同并行方式切不同对象：DP 切样本，TP 切层内张量，PP 切层，EP 切专家。它们可以组合，但不是四个互不影响的倍数。

When one device cannot handle parameters, activations or compute, work must be distributed. DP partitions samples, TP tensors within layers, PP layers and EP experts. They can combine, but are not four independent multipliers.
mechanism: TP 在一层中频繁交换部分结果，通常适合快互联；PP 在阶段间传激活，使用微批量填充流水线；DP 同步梯度或分片状态；EP 根据路由执行 token 的分发与回收。MoE 系统中 EP 常与 DP 组的布局耦合。

TP frequently exchanges partial results within a layer and favors fast links. PP transfers activations between stages and fills pipelines with microbatches. DP synchronizes gradients or sharded states. EP dispatches and gathers routed tokens; in MoE, its layout often interacts with DP groups.
questions.formula: For a simple dense mesh: devices = DP × TP × PP
example: 教学布局：16 卡可按 DP=2、TP=4、PP=2 组织。把 TP 组放到快速节点内、PP 跨阶段是可评估的起点，最终要测量；不在公式中盲目再乘 EP。Megatron 2019 展示层内并行，2021 工作研究多种并行组合。

Example: 16 devices can form DP=2, TP=4, PP=2. Placing TP groups on fast local links is a starting hypothesis to benchmark. Do not blindly multiply by EP again. Megatron 2019 demonstrated intra-layer parallelism; the 2021 work studied combinations.
limit: PP 存在气泡与阶段不均衡，TP 可能被集合通信拖慢，EP 受热门专家和 all-to-all 影响。应联合检查显存、网络拓扑、有效批量和故障恢复，而非只追求卡数。

PP has bubbles and stage imbalance, TP can be constrained by collectives, and EP by hot experts and all-to-all. Inspect memory, network topology, effective batch and fault recovery jointly rather than maximizing device count.

title: FlashAttention 为什么不改公式却更快？
Why can FlashAttention be faster with the same formula?
goal: 区分 FLOPs、显存 IO 与中间矩阵存储。
Distinguish FLOPs, memory IO and intermediate storage.
problem: 朴素注意力可能在 HBM 中物化并读写 T×T 分数和概率矩阵，数据搬运成为负担。FlashAttention 将注意力分块，尽可能在片上 SRAM 中完成局部运算，避免把完整中间矩阵写回显存。

Naive attention may materialize and repeatedly read/write T×T scores and probabilities in HBM. FlashAttention tiles the operation and performs local work in on-chip SRAM, avoiding full intermediate matrices in device memory.
mechanism: 在线 softmax 维护每行的最大值 m、归一化和 l 与加权输出。读入新的分块后，用新的最大值对已有累积量重缩放，再合并本块贡献。反向传播可重算部分中间量，用计算换 IO；数学上仍为标准注意力，浮点舍入不必逐位一致。

Online softmax maintains each row’s maximum m, normalization sum l and weighted output. Each new tile rescales previous accumulators to the updated maximum and merges its contribution. Backward can recompute intermediates, trading compute for IO. The mathematical attention is unchanged, not necessarily bitwise floating-point results.
questions.formula: m′ = max(m, max(S_tile)); l′ = e^(m−m′)l + Σe^(S_tile−m′)
example: 教学图将 HBM 中的 Q/K/V 分块搬入 SRAM，局部计算后只写所需输出与统计量。避免完整 T² 中间存储不意味着避免 T² 个稠密注意力交互。实际收益要报告序列长度、头维度、精度与硬件。

The sketch moves Q/K/V tiles from HBM into SRAM, writing required outputs and statistics. Avoiding full T² intermediate storage does not eliminate T² dense interactions. Report sequence length, head dimension, precision and hardware when measuring gains.
limit: 片上容量、线程布局与内核支持决定适用范围；小序列或特殊掩码未必有同样收益。FlashAttention 解决执行效率，不能替代长上下文能力评测或 KV 分配管理。

On-chip capacity, thread layout and kernel support define applicability. Small sequences or special masks may gain less. FlashAttention optimizes execution; it does not replace long-context evaluation or KV allocation management.

title: PagedAttention 如何减少 KV 分配浪费？
How does PagedAttention reduce KV allocation waste?
goal: 逻辑连续的序列不必占用连续物理显存。
Logically consecutive tokens need not occupy contiguous memory.
problem: 请求长度不同且输出逐步增长，预先分配最大连续缓存容易浪费，动态扩容又会产生碎片。PagedAttention 将 KV 拆成固定大小块，通过块表将序列的逻辑位置映射到非连续物理块。

Requests have different lengths and grow during generation. Reserving maximum contiguous buffers wastes memory, while resizing causes fragmentation. PagedAttention divides KV into fixed-size blocks and maps logical positions to noncontiguous physical blocks.
mechanism: 请求只在需要时获得新块；注意力内核通过块表找到对应 K/V。分支采样等场景可共享相同前缀块，并按需复制写入。它优化分配和共享，不直接压缩每个 token 的数学 KV 载荷，可与 GQA 等表示方案互补。

Requests acquire blocks as needed, and attention kernels follow the block table. Branching samples can share common prefix blocks with copy-on-write. This improves allocation and sharing rather than compressing each token’s mathematical KV payload; it complements representations such as GQA.
example: 教学算例：块大小16 token，长度33的请求需要3块、容量48，最后一块空15个位置。仍有尾块浪费与元数据成本，但不必预留整个最大窗口；实际内核配置与策略影响结果。

Example: block size 16 and length 33 need 3 blocks with capacity 48, leaving 15 unused positions. Tail waste and metadata remain, but the maximum context need not be reserved. Real kernels and allocation policies affect results.
limit: 块表间接访问、引用计数与内核实现带来复杂度；跨请求共享还需要正确的缓存键和隔离。分页提高可容纳请求数，不自动保证每个请求的延迟目标。

Indirection, reference counting and kernels add complexity. Cross-request sharing requires correct cache keys and isolation. Paging can fit more requests without automatically meeting their latency targets.

title: 连续批处理如何兼顾吞吐和用户延迟？
How does continuous batching balance throughput and latency?
goal: 在每轮迭代调度请求，而不等待整批结束。
Schedule at iteration boundaries rather than whole-batch completion.
problem: 静态请求批处理可能让短请求等待长请求，已完成槽位也不能及时补充。Orca 的迭代级调度允许完成的请求退出、新请求在迭代边界加入，提高利用率，同时引入更细粒度的调度问题。

Static request batches can make short requests wait for long ones and leave completed slots unfilled. Orca’s iteration-level scheduling admits and removes requests at iteration boundaries, improving utilization while creating finer scheduling decisions.
mechanism: 调度器结合待处理输入、正在生成的请求、token 预算和显存余量决定每轮工作。Prefill 的计算较重，decode 对每步时延敏感；大输入一次占用太多工作可能伤害正在输出的请求。分块 prefill 是可组合策略，不是所有连续批处理天然具备的性质。

Each iteration is selected from pending inputs and decoding requests under token and memory budgets. Heavy prefill work can interfere with latency-sensitive decode. Chunked prefill can complement this scheduling, but is not an automatic property of every continuous-batching implementation.
example: 教学时序：第1轮 A/B/C，B 完成后第2轮 A/D/C，A 完成后第3轮 E/D/C。替换的是请求槽位，不代表所有请求各自耗时相同。TPOT 示例公式要求输出至少2 token，均值也会隐藏尾延迟。

Teaching schedule: iteration 1 has A/B/C; after B finishes, iteration 2 has A/D/C; after A finishes, iteration 3 has E/D/C. Replacing slots does not imply equal request costs. This TPOT estimate requires at least two output tokens; means can hide tail latency.
limit: 高吞吐不等于好的交互体验。需报告 TTFT、token 间延迟、尾分位和满足 SLO 的吞吐，并给定到达率、输入／输出长度分布。过度合批可能提高吞吐却使每个用户更慢。

High throughput does not equal good interaction. Report TTFT, inter-token latency, tail percentiles and SLO-compliant throughput alongside arrival rate and length distributions. Aggressive batching may increase throughput while slowing every user.

title: Prefill／Decode 何时值得分开？
When should prefill and decode be disaggregated?
goal: 把独立扩缩容收益与状态传输成本一起算。
Compare independent scaling with state-transfer cost.
problem: Prefill 并行处理输入，decode 逐步生成，两者的计算与带宽需求以及时延目标不同。混跑可能互相干扰。DistServe 在2024年研究分离部署；NVIDIA Dynamo 在2025年披露 PD 分离，2026年进一步讨论多模态 EPD 的适用条件。

Prefill processes inputs in parallel; decode generates stepwise. They have different compute/bandwidth needs and latency targets, and may interfere when colocated. DistServe studied separation in 2024; NVIDIA Dynamo disclosed PD in 2025 and discussed multimodal EPD conditions in 2026.
mechanism: PD 把输入处理和生成放到不同资源池，传递 KV 状态，并按各自负载调度。EPD 进一步把图像／视频等编码阶段独立出来，编码输出仍需送往语言模型。收益来自减少干扰与独立配比，不来自免费获得更多计算。

PD assigns input processing and generation to separate pools, transfers KV state and schedules each workload. EPD also separates image/video encoding, whose outputs still feed the language model. Gains come from reduced interference and independent resource ratios, not free compute.
example: 教学下界：1 GiB 状态经过有效带宽25 GiB/s的链路，纯传输至少约40ms，另有排队与协调成本。若避免的干扰小于这些新增成本，分离可能不划算；需按到达率、模态、输入长度、硬件与 SLO 重测。

Teaching lower bound: 1 GiB over an effective 25 GiB/s link takes at least about 40ms, before queueing and coordination. If avoided interference is smaller than added costs, separation may lose. Reevaluate arrival rates, modality, lengths, hardware and SLOs.
limit: 低负载、短请求或慢网络可能不适合分离；独立资源池还会出现容量配比失衡。2026-09-09 的 EPD 来源是有条件的技术分析，不代表所有多模态服务都应该拆成三个池。

Low load, short requests or slow networks may favor colocation. Separate pools can become imbalanced. The September 9, 2026 EPD source is a conditional technical analysis, not a mandate to split all multimodal services into three pools.
